# statuspal-next_status_page (Data Source)

Fetches a single status page by subdomain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "statuspal-next_status_page" "acme" {
  subdomain = "acme-status"
}

output "acme_current_status" {
  value = data.statuspal-next_status_page.acme.current_status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `subdomain` (String) Status page subdomain.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `current_status` (String) Derived overall status.
- `id` (String) Status page identifier.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `notification_settings` (Attributes) Subscriber notification channels. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notification_settings))
- `require_authentication` (Boolean) Whether viewing requires sign-in.
- `timezone` (String) Primary timezone.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `website_url` (String) Reported website URL.

### Nested Schema for `notification_settings`

Read-Only:

- `email_enabled` (Boolean)
